==Location and Uses==
==={{TLoZ|-}}===
{{Descriptions TLoZ}}
The Stepladder is found in [[Level 4]] in the First Quest and in [[Level 6]] in the [[Second Quest]]. It is used to traverse small spans of [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], [[Hole]]s, or [[Lava]], which would otherwise block [[Link]]'s progress. It is used automatically when Link needs to cross any of these obstacles.

==={{TMC|-}}===
Ladders are found across [[Hyrule]] in {{TMC}}. They can be found inside [[Tree]]s, [[Secret Cave]]s, [[Minish]]-sized cracks in the [[Overworld]], and within other cave systems throughout the land. They often lead down to rooms that contain [[Chest]]s or the homes of [[Forest Picori]].

All the Ladders in the game already exist in place with the exception of one; after [[Link]] has [[Kinstone Fusion|Fused]] [[Kinstone Piece]]s with all four of the [[Tingle Siblings?]], a Ladder extends down from the center of [[North Hyrule Field]], leading to a large Chest containing the [[Magical Boomerang]].

==={{TP|-}}===
{{Stub|TPHD}}

==={{SS|-}}===
{{Stub|SS}}

==={{BotW|-}}===
Ladders are within shrines and on the sides of some buildings. They enable Link to climb without using [[Stamina]].

==={{TotK|-}}===
[[Bokoblin]]s are shown to utilize a Ladder during a mining operation in an underground cavern.

==={{EoW|-}}===

Ladders are [[Object]]s that [[Princess Zelda]] can [[Climbing|Climb]]. They are commonly found inside of [[Cave]]s or within [[Well]]s.

==Other Appearances==
==={{BSTLoZ|-}}===
{{Noncanon|Start}}
{{Stub|BSTLoZ}}
{{Noncanon|End}}

==={{ZA|-}}===
{{Noncanon|Start}}
In {{ZA}}, the Ladder can be found next to a tree in the [[Forest of Ogbam]]. Its only use is to bridge and cross the giant chasm near the entrance of the [[Shrine of Earth]].
{{Noncanon|End}}

==={{HW|-}}===
{{Noncanon|Start}}
{{Stub|HW}}
In {{HW}}, Ladders appear as [[Item Card]]s in [[Adventure Mode]].

{{Main|8-Bit Stepladder}}
In the Master Quest DLC Pack for {{HW}}, the [[8-Bit Stepladder]] from {{TLoZ|-}} appears as a [[Weapon]] for [[Sheik]]. It is part of the [[Harp]] Weapon-type, and statistically-identical to the [[Triforce Harp]].
{{Noncanon|End}}
